quotes.text: Whether falling upon the faithful Moonlit Current or the greedy Shadow Stream, she gave her Sacred Measure—half her essence, always.
You are no longer Rain who chooses to be fair; you are Rain whose fairness is immutable.
"Give the Sacred Measure to all—half your bounty. Return fairly to all—half what you receive.
She had become the strategy itself—immutable, recognizable, true.
"We have heard of your constancy," they said.
A young cloud asked, "Will you now give more, trusting this proven partner completely?"

note: R3 hints rains cease for takers, later gives half even to the greedy Shadow Stream; Sacred Measure becomes identity.
